text:
ana: opened a docs PR to correct the API reference for POST /v1/generate. found a few mismatches when running the quick SDK smoke tests.

ana: issues:
- temperature is defined as integer enum (0|1) in openapi.yaml but runtime accepts floats like 0.7.
- response example in the ref doesn't show the optional 'warnings' array that runtime returns when a prompt is truncated or safety filters trigger.

chris: can you paste the exact snippets so i can patch the OpenAPI file and bump the generated SDK types?

ana: current (incorrect) param snippet:
```yaml
parameters:
  temperature:
    type: integer
    enum: [0, 1]
```
should be:
```yaml
parameters:
  temperature:
    type: number
    format: float
    minimum: 0.0
    maximum: 1.0
    description: "Sampling temperature; 0.0 = deterministic, 1.0 = stochastic"
```

zahra: add warnings as optional array[string] in the response schema. also suggest adding a short note that clients generating strict types need to regenerate.

mike: i'll add a tiny JS example in the API reference for handling warnings: `if (resp.warnings?.length) console.warn('generate warnings', resp.warnings)` — leaves it simple for teams migrating.

dev-doc-bot: openapi-check reported 1 broken anchor in docs/guides/usage.md: line 89

ana: fixed the link and force-pushed. pushed OpenAPI changes: temperature -> number, added warnings: {type: array, items: {type: string}}, and marked metadata as additionalProperties: true with description 'unstable internal fields'.

chris: LGTM from eng side. left one nit about wording on the metadata description.

zahra: i reviewed the docs changes; approving. please add a short migration note under docs/migration/v1.2.md calling out the temperature type change.

mike: added migration note and a one-liner code snippet to the SDK README in the PR.

dev-doc-bot: CI: All checks passed \u2705 (lint, unit, openapi-check)

ana: merged. i'll open a follow-up to propagate the example into python and go SDKs.
